lines: 『Ahhh, shit!! Crush those guys, my happy ones!!』
They were both an attack and a shield at the same time.
The Taimanin, who had a duty to protect people, couldn't harm the rioters, who were ordinary members of the public by nature.
The cunning monster was well aware of that, and taking advantage of it.
She pointed that at the approaching rioters, and unleashed all the demonic power that she had put into her blade at once.
The rioters crumpled over one after another, like puppets with their strings cut.
Kurenai's ultimate skill, Godeye Sword, which could see and sever the very existence of anything.
By using that, she had severed only the monster's binding spell, which was controlling the rioters.
「Hey, you're not bad!! Well then, next it's my turn――」
An icicle rose up from directly below the monster.
A gigantic mass of ice that Kirara had charged full of her “Frost Kijin” power.
The monster, which had seen that the situation was unfavourable and been trying to flee, was trapped inside it beautifully.
『O-Oi, oi?! What is this? Eh?! Eeeeehhhhh?!』
Naturally, it couldn't move even a twitch.
And reflected in the eyes of the Spirit of Halloween, which was about to pee itself with fear,
Were the figures of two women, approaching with the glints in their eyes of wild beasts hunting their prey.
『N-No, no, wait wait wait?! It's all right, if we talk it out, I'm sure we'll come to an understa――』
「My vacuum blades will tear everything to pieces――Special move: Whirlwind Swarm!!!」
「This is the power of the oni race! Killer blow: Go With the Floe―――h!!!」
Struck by Kurenai's blade and Kirara's charge, the monster was smashed apart along with the icicle that sealed off its movements.
Sparkling shards of ice fluttered down over the neon-adorned Halloween streets.
The monster, which had had its body shattered and been put into a state of mere thought, smiled weakly.
『But, well...... perhaps this was for the best......』
『Because...... happiness that's forced by someone isn't true happiness, is it......? Heh heh...』
While saying something that sounded like it had finally now realized that, the nuisance monster disappeared into the Halloween night.
The two of them high-fived triumphantly.
They had made an excellent team.
United on the common ground of 『I don't have time for this,』 the pair had completed their missions in a flash, with eye-opening coordination.
Now the people who were being controlled would also come to their senses, and the mayhem in the streets would die down.
「I'm Onisaki Kirara! I'm a Taimanin from Gosha. And you?」
「Shinganji Kurenai. I'm a Taimanin who's operating away from Gosha for various reasons.」
「Oh, that's the first time I'm hearing about this. So there's a girl like that, huh?」
「Um-hmm. Although, that doesn't mean I'm hostile to Gosha. Please don't be on guard.」
「Of course not! You seem like a good person!」
It seemed that a strange sense of solidarity had been created by having fought for similar goals.
「Th-Thanks...... Uh, I'm a little embarrassed to be told that to my face......」
「Come to think of it, are you also going to the Halloween festival today?」
「Actually, that's why I was in a hurry. You're also dressed similarly, so...」
Kurenai pointed between each other's costumes.
Despite introducing themselves as Taimanin, they were both dressed in rather festive outfits.
「Ah, that's right! I was about to go for Halloween too.」
「I was invited to go with a junior who I've made friends with recently!」
Kirara said, while recalling the face of her junior, Fuuma Kotarou.
「He's a bit of a cocky guy, but, well～, he's so cute I can't leave him alone♪」
「Fufu, is that so......? I'm jealous that you've got a junior you're so close with.」
「You could say that♪ But, it's something similar for you too, right?」
「You were fighting in a real hurry, so you must've got a date with someone important, right?」
「W-Well...... You're right. Someone important, which is to say......」
「I've been invited to the festival by a childhood friend I haven't seen in a long while......」
Kurenai said, while recalling the face of her childhood friend, Fuuma Kotarou.
「Unlike me, someone who's...... cheery, and popular with everyone, and...... basically amazing!」
「Ohh～, childhood friend?! That's pretty nice, isn't it?♪」
The two of them hit it off as they each put their delicate feelings into words for one another.
Incidentally, neither of them realized at all that the people they were talking about were the same.
「Y-Yeah. That's how it is, so I've got to hurry to the meeting place!」
「You're right! Let's go together part of the way♪」
「Damn Fuuma. He's late! We wanted to change earlier, and yet...」
「Indeed. Hebiko wonders if he's gotten lost or something?」
At the meeting place, a uniform-wearing Shikanosuke and Hebiko were waiting for everyone else.
The two of them had come straight from school, so their costumes were in their bags.
Kotarou, who was the one to suggest this in the first place, had been with them for some of the way, but
Saying, 「Dammit! I forgot my costume!」, he had headed back home for the moment.
「I mean, coming today we've also got Kirara-senpai and...... Hebiko and Fuuma's childhood friend, was it?」
「What kind of person is she? Fuuma said he met her earlier, for the first time in ages.」
Hebiko nodded, and Shikanosuke asked that with great interest.
「Yeah. It's been a long time since Hebiko's seen her too, so she doesn't know about anything recently......」
「But Kurenai-chan's a good girl. She's really diligent and kindhearted!」
「Oh, really? Then, you think I'll be able to make friends with her too?!」
「Of course♪ Ahh～, but still, they're all late............ Oh?」
She noticed two people making their way through the crowd.
Their senpai, Onisaka Kirara, and another person.
「Ah, there they are! Oooi, Hebiko-chan, Shikanosuke-kun! Sorry to keep you waiting～♪」
「No, Hebiko's saying――That person is Kurenai-chan. Hebiko's childhood friend!」
Kirara opened her eyes wide and looked at Kurenai.
「N-No, hold on, Hebiko! Then, this girl is――」
「Onisaki Kirara-senpai. One of the people going with Heberybody today.」
They looked at each other's faces.
It was at this point that they finally realized. That both of them had been in a hurry for exactly the same reason.
「Oh, that's what it was. But why're you two together?」
「W-Well...... I was subduing a monster with her a little while ago, and――」
Bewildered, Kurenai explained the course of events leading up to this.
Kirara was letting that go in one ear and out the other, as she thought about something else entirely.
（She's Fuuma and Hebiko-chan's childhood friend......? Then, that means the “important person” she was just talking about is――）
No matter how she thought about it, there was only one person who matched Kurenai's words――!
（Hebiko-chan?!! C-Come to think of it, as I recall......）
（She was staring hungrily at the octopus dumplings at that stand on the way......!）
「I see～. Well, anyway, I'm Uehara Shikanosuke. Let's be friends, Kurenai!」
（He's the “junior I've made friends with recently” that she was talking about before......）
Hearing “junior”, she had thought that meant Kotarou for a moment, but she soon realized that was wrong.
“So cute I can't leave him alone” was a little different.
「Th-That's right, isn't it......? How should I put this...? Once again, nice to meet you, Kurenai.」
「A “you-know-what” between girls might get tough, but I'll be rooting for you!!」
「?? I don't really get it, but...... Anyway, it feels like I can get on well with you!」
The two of them displayed smiles.
And thus, despite making a couple of spectacular misunderstandings, Kurenai and Kirara became friends.
Working his way through the crowd, a young man came along wearing a clown costume, which he must have changed into at home.
Beckoning him were Hebiko, Shikanosuke, and...

「You're finally here, then, Fuuma?!」
「You're finally here, huh, Fuuma?!」
Two people in Halloween costumes turned around, with smiles across their faces.
